blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Agriculture & Food Systems level this capability reads as: custody events from plot to pallet with master-data discipline (recall queries answered in minutes). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Below is the delivery cadence for this capability — the same pattern on every engagement. The first two weeks lock the baseline: your team and ours measure the current metric together and sign it. Weeks 3–8 carry the pilot on bounded scope — a single decision path, workflow, plant or portfolio — and a control owner on your side owns the evidence. Weeks 9–12 industrialize: runbooks, monitoring, enablement, and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Missing a gate produces a documented decision to stop or redirect — never a silent extension.
